name: Primander - Decay
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Decay periodically creates a [Decaying Swamp] around itself.
[Decaying Swamp]: Deals periodic damage to enemies within its radius, while simultaneously healing allies inside.

name: Primander - Blast
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Blast periodically triggers an explosion centred on itself, launching nearby hostile units into the air.

name: Primander - Wither
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Wither periodically unleashes 3 rotating [Withering Beams].
[Withering Beam]: Lasts for 10s. Circles the Primander, dealing damage to targets on contact and reducing their Sanity.

name: Primander - Frostbite
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
When Primander – Frostbite is hit by a ranged weapon, it retaliates by firing icicles at the attacker, dealing damage and applying 1 stack of [Slowness].
[Slowness]: Reduces Attack Speed and Movement Speed for 3s, up to 5 stacks.

name: Primander - Icehell
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Icehell periodically summons an [Icehell] beneath hostile targets.
[Icehell]: Slows targets within its radius, then detonates after 2.5s, dealing AoE damage to all hostile targets in range.

name: Primander - Sacrifice
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Sacrifice explodes upon defeat, dealing damage to all hostile targets within range.

name: Primander - Corrosion
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Corrosion periodically generates a pool of [Venom] beneath its feet.
[Venom]: Inflicts a DEF reduction and deals periodic damage to targets within its area.
Additionally, Primander – Corrosion accelerates Serum decay while alive.

name: Primander - Glimmer
desc:

Primander – Glimmer periodically applies [Glimmer] to itself.
[Glimmer]: Lasts for 2.5s. During this time, taking damage will trigger an explosion that deals AoE damage to hostile targets within range.

name: Primander - Revenge
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Revenge empowers nearby allies when defeated.
[Empowered]: Increases ATK, DEF, Movement Speed, and Attack Speed for 20s.

name: Primander - Guard
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Guard periodically summons a [Guardian Field] around itself.
[Guardian Field]: Lasts for 9s and blocks all incoming hostile bullets and projectiles.

name: Primander - Phantom
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Phantom summons 2 [Phantom(s)] at the start of battle.
[Phantom]: Takes increased damage but mirrors its summoner's combat abilities.

name: Primander - Thunderclap
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Thunderclap periodically releases [Electro Orbs] that radiate outward.
[Electro Orb]: Discharges electricity every 0.5s, dealing damage to nearby hostile targets. Disappears after being attacked.

name: Primander - Thunderstorm
desc:
Primanders are powerful entities among the hostile forces that wield unique Primander abilities.
Primander – Thunderstorm periodically summons multiple [Thunder Hells] around itself.
[Thunder Hell]: Spins across the field relentlessly, dealing damage to any hostile target on contact.
